title: Sprint Bridge Circuit — agenda + action tracker (prep)
content:
Purpose: quick, focused 35–40m bridge between serving runtime, infra and console owners. Goal is to surface regressions, unblock rollouts, and lock on next-week owners for latency experiments.

Audience: runtime leads, infra oncall, console PM/engineer, SRE liaison.

Format (timeboxed):
- 0–3m: quick round (who is here + 30s highlight)
- 3–12m: hot incidents / regressions (only actionable items)
- 12–22m: rollout status (console + dedicated + experiments)
- 22–32m: experiments / perf work / tradeoffs deep-dive (rotating owner)
- 32–35m: action items + owners + due dates + follow-ups
- Optional 35–40m: overflow or siesta pair-ins

Prep notes (things I want to say / ask):
- Quick ask: confirm if we keep KV-cache tuning on by default for prod 2-host tests (saw 4% tail latency bump on canary).
- Note to self: highlight the two recent flakiness spikes at ~2026-03-09 11:42 UTC (p50 OK, p99 up). Attach trace IDs.
- Console: ask PM about rollout gate for model-alias switching (need explicit A/B flag).
- Infra: remind about capacity reservation for upcoming Dedicated customer test on 2026-03-18.
- SRE: request extra 24h retention on traces for the next week to debug KV eviction pattern.

Hot issues (brief bullets I will paste):
- p99 spike on canary (2026-03-09 11:42): increased preprocess CPU contended with disk IO — mitigation: throttle prefetcher in canary. Track: INF-4382.
- failing healthchecks in us-west-2-b (3/11 morning): autoscaler restarted nodes during heavy rollout — suspected leader election flapping. Temporary fix: raised leader election timeouts.

Rollout status (what to call out):
- Console: ember/feature/alias-a11y PR merged, staged behind feature flag — need decide exposure criteria (metrics threshold + error budget). See PR #612.
- Dedicated: capacity reservation for customer ACME corp scheduled; infra needs explicit VLAN + KMS keys provisioned by 3/16.
- Hosted API: quantized Llama-13B variant (q4_0) in canary; quality regressions flagged on eval set 1 (regression: softened stop tokens).

Experiments / perf work (rotate owner each week):
- This week's deep-dive owner: Maya — topic: continuous batching window tuning and impact on p50/p95.
- Next week owner: Diego — investigate kernel-selection heuristics on A100s vs H100s.

Notes to self: rough conversation bullets for Maya:
- Share the workload histogram from last 7 days (attach link): median seq 128, 95th seq 1024. Ask: is batcher respecting sequence length skew?
- Confirm batching budget vs latency SLO tradeoff — recommend bumping max batch size from 64 to 96 in canary.

Action items (explicit list for meeting; will capture owner + due):
- A1: Infra to confirm VLAN + KMS provisioning for ACME Dedicated test — owner: Diego Rivera — due: 2026-03-16 — blocker: security approval (ticket SEC-2201).
- A2: Runtime to roll back temporary prefetch throttle in prod canary after metric stability confirmed — owner: Jasper Lin — due: 2026-03-13 EOD — note: coordinate with SRE on trace collection.
- A3: Console PM to define feature-exposure threshold for alias switching (metrics + error budget) — owner: Amar Singh — due: 2026-03-15 — link: PR #612.
- A4: SRE to enable 48h extra trace retention for KV eviction window on canary cluster — owner: Maya Patel — due: 2026-03-14 — follow-up: share extracted traces on Confluence.
- A5: Research spike: bench kernel-selection heuristics across instance types — owner: Diego Rivera — due: 2026-03-20 — deliverable: 1-page summary + perf table.

Follow-ups I want to leave the room with (notes to capture in retro):
- Decide whether to make KV-cache tuning opt-in or opt-out for new model rollouts (proposal next week).
- Add an explicit rollout step in Console: preflight smoke test + latency baseline check (automated).
- Improve SLO dashboard to surface batch-size-induced latency skew (new metric panel).

Links / artifacts to paste in meeting chat quickly:
- Canary traces dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/trace-canary/canary-traces
- Infra ticket: JIRA INF-4382 (p99 canary spike)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/612
- Confluence notes draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/kv-cache-tuning-draft

Quick table (for my eyes) — owners and current status:
- Diego Rivera — infra — VLAN/KMS for ACME (blocked)
- Maya Patel — SRE/perf — batching deep-dive (in-progress)
- Amar Singh — console PM — alias exposure criteria (draft)
- Jasper Lin — runtime — prefetch throttle rollback (wip)

Questions I might ask live:
- "Amar — can you give a 2-minute proposal for rollout stop-gap if alias exposure breaches error budget?"
- "Maya — what top-three trace spans should we look at first for KV eviction?"
- "Diego — if security delays KMS, do we have temporary isolated cluster option?"

Loose TODO (personal):
- Before meeting: attach 2 representative traces + p99 spike graph to the doc.
- During meeting: capture any new ticket numbers and assign owners immediately in chat.
- After meeting: convert action items to JIRA with links back into this doc.

Scratch notes / truncated thoughts (not for meeting):
- Consider small experiment to shadow requests to q4_0 model and compare logits distribution to fp16 baseline. Might catch stop-token drift.
- Might be worth a short RFC: standardized rollout checklist across hosted/dedicated/private so Console can enforce gates.

End of prep.

-- Jasper (quick dump)
